recipes.description: Review architecture, coupling, hotspots, and maintenance risk without changing the workspace.
Check delivered work against requirements with independent evidence.
Explore interface alternatives and a synthesized hybrid recommendation.
Review a product plan with independent critics and a verified synthesis.
Research stack, testing, and alignment evidence before the coordinator writes the final plan.
Execute dependency-partitioned scopes with claims, parent verification, and gap escalation.
Create a bounded Scope Map for the existing Scope stage.
Optionally inspect the repository before the coordinator starts context work.
Gather bounded evidence for shaping while the coordinator retains product decisions.
Run selected strategic analyses in parallel and synthesize evidence.
Produce an evidence-based testing strategy as a planning input.
Review a live or described interface for usability, accessibility, and visual quality without changing code.
Verify implementation through tests, UI checks, and an evidence review.
